capabilities: Match path queries segment by segment against note aliases and folder-note aliases
Rank and render matches with markers explaining how each row matched
Add aliases to notes from a command or the file explorer menu
Search notes by frontmatter property values using core Search term syntax
Insert links to notes found by property terms while typing [[
extras: Documentation is itself a demo vault that ships with every release and can be opened with a command, downloaded as a zip, or browsed on GitHub; beta versions install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: this plugin extends that shape to the rest of the path rather than inventing a second one to learn
problem: Obsidian's quick switcher matches a query against the path or the note's alias but never a mixture of the two, and no switcher consults folder-note aliases.

relations.evidence: This plugin requires Advanced Metadata Cache: it loads nothing until that plugin is installed and enabled
If the Folder notes plugin is installed, its live configuration decides which note belongs to a folder

summary: Alias-aware quick switcher that matches aliases in every path segment, including folder-note aliases, and finds notes by frontmatter property terms.
